structure.unit: Waters of the State, Ports and Harbors

law.catch_line: Power of cities to bind themselves to perform or execute assurances
law.text: The cities defined in § 62.1-155 shall have the power to irrevocably bind themselves to do any and all things necessary to perform or execute the assurances authorized to be given pursuant to § 62.1-156 anything in the charters of such cities to the contrary notwithstanding.
